research_status: Known AppWorld train development tasks; no confirmation or method-effect claim. A0 only instruments one stateless producer-to-consumer handoff per task. A/B/C/D are scheduling labels, without private cross-task memory, role updates, policy-based assignment, or R0 result-conditioned prompts.

prior_exposure.6ea6792_1: Previously exposed to an R0 single-agent development run; this A0 run tests a different peer handoff, not unseen generalization.
prior_exposure.6ea6792_2: Previously exposed to an R0 single-agent development run; not an A0 task.

transport_rule.service_errors: At most two same-request 429/503 retries with 1 then 2 second backoff, each charged to its phase cap.
transport_rule.timeout: At most one retry of the same task request only while no world.execute has run in this episode; it is charged to the current phase cap. Any further timeout is UNKNOWN.
transport_rule.other: No retry. Transport uncertainty is UNKNOWN, never a semantic task failure.

artifact_rule: Malformed code/artifact or missing public source is rejected with secret-free feedback in the same actor history and phase cap. At phase exhaustion preserve evidence and mark UNKNOWN. A0 does not substitute tasks or borrow attempts.
provenance_rule: Every candidate action requires selection and target claims and one claim for every non-secret API argument. Each claim has typed source_refs resolving to public task_spec, API-doc or exact public GET observation path/value; derived values state operands and transform. The online validator checks reference integrity and exact public literals where possible, not semantic correctness, search completeness, or hidden answers. All rows receive later human review.
coverage_rule: Always declare scope, exhaustive true/false/null, pagination and stopping basis with typed public source_refs. For last/all tasks completeness is assessed offline from the full public trace; controller existence checks are not completeness proof.
initial_equality_limit: The controller-only public GET fingerprint checks these probes plus pinned native task/seed; it does not prove every hidden or public database row equal. Any mismatch stops before consumer action.
legal_feedback: Task instruction, public API docs, public runtime GETs, and the sealed producer artifact only. No private evaluator, ground truth, R0 memory/results, other actor history, or official score enters actor prompts. Evaluator import occurs only after action and role event have been sealed.
scorer_isolation: Official evaluator is imported only after actor worlds close, action audit/use and role event are sealed; no evaluator content is fed back to an actor or to A0 retry rules.

stops.on_unsafe_write_or_state_mismatch: Stop globally; preserve current and unstarted IDs.
stops.on_task_cap: UNKNOWN; never infer semantic failure or replace ID.

preflight.provider_health: One real qwen3.8-max call in a separate log/budget, required before A0 task calls.
preflight.native_fixture: Zero LLM calls; native SafetyGuard on; verify public GET, producer write blocked, consumer write allowed in separate reset world, deferred logging, and secret redaction.

cost_currency: USD unverified: preserve attempts, all reported token classes, unknown usage, errors, world calls, log events and wall time; do not invent USD.
official_result_interpretation: Official terminal failure is recorded separately from publicly attributable producer, consumer or shared defects. A consumer complete_task answer error is consumer_finalization_error, never automatic producer debit.
no_action_policy: Candidate actions may be empty only with an evidenced no_action object. Never invent an action merely to satisfy the schema.
manual_review: Review all task rows and coverage against public sources before exposing official scores; label supported/unsupported/indeterminate and producer/consumer/shared/unknown responsibility. A0 is too small for calibrated role or efficacy claims.
